newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul raises foreign stock-index futures limit.
newsitem.headline: Seoul raises foreign stock-index futures limit.

text.p: South Korea said on Monday it set the ceiling for foreign stock-index futures investment in June at 6,228 contracts, up from 5,705 contracts in May.
The Securities Supervisory Board (SSB) said the limit on futures investment by individual foreigners was set at 1,038 contracts, compared with 950 contracts.
The ceiling for foreigners is set at 30 percent of the daily average number of total open interests during the preceding three months, which was 20,761, the SSB said.
